monthly_unlock_schedule.statement: The official page states that up to 127 million STRK, or 1.27 percent of total supply, have been and will be unlocked on the fifteenth of each month from 2025-04-15 through 2027-03-15.

limitations: This record authenticates the project's source check, not an immutable copy of the third-party webpage.
